The actress who played the main girl character (Michelle Jones/Spider-Woman) in *Spider-Man: Homecoming* is **Zendaya**. She was signed to the record label **Hollywood Records** during her active music career.

According to the search results:
- Zendaya signed with Hollywood Records in August 2012
- She released her debut studio album "Zendaya" in September 2013 under Hollywood Records
- The album reached number 51 on the US Billboard 200
- Her last major music release was in February 2016

So the answer is **Hollywood Records**.
